objective: Run fast cold-player tests on current playable versions while polishing one flagship game, using verified game starts/ends and new clear gameplay clips.

guardrails.aiDisclosure: Accurately disclose generative AI use wherever platform rules require; never conceal AI use to evade moderation.
guardrails.externalPosts: Never auto-submit to an unapproved subreddit or forum. Verify current community rules and moderation precedents before a one-off human-approved post.
guardrails.bulkPosts: Do not submit seven launch announcements at once or repost to circumvent deletion.
guardrails.lowValueCampaigns: Do not create new routine promotion on paused channels; already scheduled posts are not proof of publication or acquisition.
guardrails.qualityGate: Only one individually reviewed CrazyGames candidate; Poki after quality, originality and first-time-player tests.
guardrails.conversionMetric: Prioritize start_events and completed_runs, not views, likes, or follows.
guardrails.stopRule: After at least 14 days and 3 distinct posts per test channel, stop if no attributed game starts, unless data ingestion was unavailable.
guardrails.blueskyAccount: Metricool is now connected to @morrowwishgames.bsky.social. The retired ruckusbutton account must not receive any new promotion.
guardrails.socialCrossposting: Never recycle previously published old-version blurry video. Produce new high-definition recordings of current verified gameplay before any new YouTube Shorts/TikTok/Instagram Reels upload. Do not delete existing public videos unless misleading, broken, or user specifically directs.
guardrails.testingCadence: Two parallel tracks: keep seven itch.io games playable and polish Cat Bond; test freshly recorded sharp footage in P1 short-form platforms. Fix one high-friction obstacle each 3-4 days; aim for about 20 verified cold-player test sessions before CrazyGames re-review.
